meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找回之前会话中解决过的问题和做法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常想从过往对话里快速找回答案。
copy.tagline_en: Recall past solutions and how you did things before.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to dig up answers from earlier conversations.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能搜索跨会话的持久记忆库,按「搜索→时间线→取详情」三步走:先给出带 ID 的索引表,再只取你选中 ID 的完整记录。
howto.when: 当你问“这个我们是不是已经解决过?”“上次 X 是怎么做的?”等关于以往会话的问题时触发,而不是当前对话。

say.text: 搜一下记忆里关于 authentication 的记录
say.note: 返回带 ID 的索引表,每条约 50~100 token

say.text: 上次我们是怎么修 token 过期问题的?
say.note: 先搜索,再对相关条目取完整详情

say.text: 看一下 #11131 前后各 3 条时间线
say.note: 显示该条目前后的观察、会话与提示

howto.what_en: Claude can search a persistent cross-session memory database using a search → timeline → fetch workflow: it first returns an index table with IDs, then fetches full details only for the IDs you pick.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about previous sessions, e.g. "did we already solve this?" or "how did we do X last time?", rather than the current conversation.

say_en.note: Returns an index table with IDs, ~50-100 tokens each

say_en.text: How did we fix token expiration last time?
say_en.note: Searches first, then fetches full details for relevant hits

say_en.text: Show the timeline around #11131, 3 items each way
say_en.note: Shows observations, sessions and prompts around that item
